title: Epidemiology of Sexually Transmitted Infections and Its iMpAcT on fEmale Infertility
official: Epidemiology of Sexually Transmitted Infections and Its iMpAcT on fEmale Infertility
summary: A longitudinal study to investigate the prevalence of sexually transmitted infections among young women and determine the role of the female genital tract microbiome in fertility
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18-22 years
* informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* sterilization
* not capable of giving informed consent
